architecture.reason: V3.6 immutability forbids enum extension; a new wrapper duplicates the validated engine. A schedule layer reuses MC2/Phase-7/V3.6 mechanics, supports multi-step, keeps CRN, and leaves V3.8/V3.10 integration points.

ALTERNATIVE_COMPOUND_PLAN.reason: Requested-compound override mechanics exist (sampled transition overridden; loss/age/stint effects). No explicit compound pace delta (frozen) — disclosed, not pretended. V3.6D shows distinguishable compound effects via loss/age mechanics.

COMPETITOR_STRATEGY.reason: MC2 produces joint field futures (gapless FinishOrder), so rival-pit effects propagate through ordering — but traffic/overtaking is gated off, so only pit-cycle ordering effects, never battles. Needs multi-target plan support (same extension as MULTI_STOP_PLAN).
COMPETITOR_STRATEGY.required_mechanics: multi-target plan; propagation limited to ordering.
COMPETITOR_STRATEGY.temporal_safety_risk: MEDIUM: must not imply traffic effects the simulator lacks.

DRIVER_RETIREMENT.reason: No reliability hazard family exists (R3/R6); reliability_enabled=True is rejected, not faked; kernel never simulates DNFs. Frozen post-T retirements forbidden.
DRIVER_RETIREMENT.required_mechanics: calibrated retirement hazard (out of V3.7 scope).

MULTI_DRIVER.reason: Single-target plans today (_InterventionPlan has one target_index; one intervention per run). Simultaneous plans need conflict semantics (same-lap compound conflicts, pit-constraint handling, retirement/finish cancellation) plus CRN extension over schedules.
MULTI_DRIVER.required_mechanics: multi-target schedule; fail-closed conflict rules; per-(seed,index) stream discipline across targets.
MULTI_DRIVER.temporal_safety_risk: MEDIUM: order dependence / RNG contamination must be excluded.

MULTI_STOP_PLAN.reason: Engine runs carry exactly one intervention (_InterventionPlan/_InterventionTracker, one decision_lap). A second forced stop needs a schedule-capable engine extension with conflict semantics. Chained runs from simulated states are REJECTED (breaks factual provenance and CRN).
MULTI_STOP_PLAN.required_mechanics: CounterfactualPlan schedule type; multi-event tracker; conflict resolution (fail-closed or frozen deterministic).
MULTI_STOP_PLAN.temporal_safety_risk: MEDIUM: later events must key off simulated, never historical, state.

PIT_IN_N_LAPS.reason: Single-intervention mechanics generalize: the note_completion decision rule already waits (PIT_NEXT_LAP forces at decision_lap+2 with baseline at +1). Extending the wait window with per-lap baseline-pit supersession needs a B-stage contract, not new simulator mechanics.
PIT_IN_N_LAPS.required_mechanics: N-window supersession rule in plan contract (B).
PIT_IN_N_LAPS.temporal_safety_risk: LOW: trigger reads simulated state only.
PIT_IN_N_LAPS.validation_requirement: execution-rate vs N curve; horizon cap evidence in D.

RACE_STATE_EDITS.reason: Gaps, positions, tyre ages, and pace are state facts, not user-editable interventions. Arbitrary edits risk physically impossible states.

SAFETY_CAR.reason: No deployment trigger, duration, compression, restart, pit-loss-change, or tyre-effect mechanics exist (regime_support: SC DEFERRED, compression/restart out of scope; kernel never simulates SC). Active-SC states are ineligible; dry-green runs never generate SC.
SAFETY_CAR.required_mechanics: causal trigger + duration + compression + restart models (out of V3.7 scope).
SAFETY_CAR.temporal_safety_risk: HIGH: historical SC reuse is the natural failure mode.

TRACK_STATUS_RED_FLAG.reason: All non-green regimes deferred (YELLOW/VSC/RED); historical occurrence does not imply generative capability.

UNDERCUT_OVERCUT_PRIMITIVE.reason: Narrative labels, not interventions: no separate causal mechanism exists beyond pit-timing differences. Admitted only as DERIVED descriptions (plan-vs-plan deltas plus driver-vs-driver outcomes).
UNDERCUT_OVERCUT_PRIMITIVE.temporal_safety_risk: LOW as derived; HIGH if primitized (fake mechanism).
UNDERCUT_OVERCUT_PRIMITIVE.validation_requirement: derived-description discipline in B/G copy guards.

WEATHER.reason: No stochastic weather evolution exists (WET DEFERRED: no causal transition mechanism). Historical post-T weather reuse is forbidden.
WEATHER.required_mechanics: causal weather evolution + tyre response (out of scope).

compute_policy: Plan count multiplies 5000-future cost: horizons x compounds x drivers x multi-stop combos. Prune on scientific validity (eligibility, execution collapse), never on top-strategy heuristics. No broad cache build in V3.7A.
conflict_policy: Fail closed or frozen deterministic semantics; never silently resolve. Same-lap same-driver conflicts, cross-driver pit constraints, post-retirement/finish cancellations specified in B.

crn_generalization.divergence: Schedule-dependent pit-domain draw counts and supersession/cancellation paths are documented structural divergence; complete-pair accounting preserved; no claim that CRN removes model uncertainty.
crn_generalization.schedule_rule: same initial state, same stream family, same index; schedules differ only.

definition.causal_boundary: T: everything at or before T is factual input; everything after T is either MC2-simulated (allowed) or historical (forbidden as input).
definition.counterfactual: SIMULATOR-CONDITIONAL OUTCOMES UNDER CONTROLLED INTERVENTIONS: MC2 futures generated from a causal RaceState(T) after a controlled post-T modification.
definition.factual_state: information observed at or before T.
definition.historical_future: what actually happened after T. FORBIDDEN as simulation input; allowed only as explicitly designed post-hoc context/evaluation.
definition.intervention: a controlled modification imposed after T.
not_established: causal treatment effects in the real world
definition.simulated_consequence: future state generated by MC2 after the intervention.

evaluation_design.sampling: deterministic preregistered policy in D (no post-hoc selection).

intervention_horizon.max_n: No fixed small cap in contract (any fixed N would be UI arbitrary). V3.7B freezes the window mechanics; V3.7D sets an evidence cap if execution collapses beyond N*.
intervention_horizon.rule: N >= 1; N <= remaining_laps - 1; the trigger reads SIMULATED state only; a baseline pit on any earlier lap supersedes the plan; race end cancels.

leakage_threat_model.rule: Post-T historical pit/compounds/lap-times/positions/gaps/status/retirement/race-control/SC/weather/finish/team-strategy: forbidden as input; allowed only as explicitly designed post-hoc context/evaluation; simulated futures are the only admissible post-T driver.

admitted.P_AHEAD_OF_RIVAL: joint futures exist; per-pair rival retention is B/C plumbing, not new mechanics.

product_questions: What if Norris waited three laps before stopping?
How does PIT L+2 compare with PIT L+5?
How does this plan change the probability of finishing ahead of Verstappen?

reference.plan_vs_plan: Admitted as secondary comparisons with identical CRN/pair discipline; never replaces the canonical reference; no historical-future baseline.

schedule_abstraction.decision: Compositional CounterfactualPlan (ordered intervention list), not PIT_IN_2/PIT_IN_3/... enums. Decided in A; built in C.

state_machine.note: V3.6 vocabulary reused (INERT/SUPERSEDED/CANCELLED/TERMINAL). PLANNED/ELIGIBLE added for pre-trigger schedule members. Transitions frozen in B.

v35_boundary: V3.5 learned probabilities stay outside counterfactual computation.
v38_boundary: V3.8 owns model x simulation consensus/fusion.
verdict: V3.7A COMPLETE — COUNTERFACTUAL CONTRACT FROZEN — READY FOR V3.7B
